title: Luscious Savory Polish Goose Fat Skillet
description: A hearty, savory dish reminiscent of traditional Polish cuisine, featuring crumbly goose fat as the base. It's perfect for a weeknight dinner, and can be easily adapted to a plant-based version by substituting the goose fat with a vegan alternative.
instructions: Heat the goose fat in a tava-griddle over medium-high heat until it reaches 350°F (175°C).
Add the sliced sweet onions and cook until they're translucent and slightly caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the onions and mushrooms and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until it thickens, about 2-3 minutes.
Season with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve hot.
